Combined Attack: Allows any two martial attacks with any two limbs. Speed for both is the longer of the two attacks.
Stunning Head Blow: Two martial punches to either side of the head. Doubles chance of unconsciousness per point of physical damage (from 2% to 4%)
Eye Gouge: Two simultaneous Finger Punches if either are successful then an Eye Gouge is made for each. Success equals equals permanent eye loss.
Death Strike: vs. 6 or less armor. Attacker must be within 2' of target height. Rake against the neck or Hell Strike to the nose. Causes immediate death if success.
Feather Block: Combined with any other block, +1 second. If successful all damage is mitigated.
Crushing Hold: Combined with any other hold. Does 3d6 crushing damage per 5 seconds to held areas.
Punch Throw: Martial Punch to the upper body combined with a Leg Throw. Must make Martial Punch first to roll this skill in place of the Leg Throw.
Kick Throw: Martial Kick to the lower body combined with a Arm, Shoulder or Body Throw. Must make Martial Kick first to roll this skill in place of the Throw.
Slam: Added to any Throw (except leg). Make a STR Save with skill roll. If both are successful, 1d6 damage per 5 full points of STR. +2 seconds to throw used.
Martial Disarm: Disarm an opponent as a contest of this skill roll versus the oppenent's AGL Save. If made by quarter and opponent loses AGL Save the weapon can be taken instead of disarm.
Flip: Cannot attack. If successful -4 to be hit. Fail requires AGL Save to land on their feet.
Wall Jump: Combined with jump or flying move, adds +2 more AGL for jump moves.
